out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Having a CFM Present
violations.observation: Observed no CFM available to assist staff with performing duties such as setting up 3 compartment sink to properly wash, rinse, and sanitize kitchen equipment and utensils. EHS observed quat sanitizer solution dispenser not properly working. EHS observed bleach/ chlorine available but no chlorine test strips available.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed PIC to CFM (off duty) for instructions on free-pouring the quat sanitizer solution until dispenser is repaired. EHS provided PIC chlorine test strips to use chlorine sanitizer solution for sanitizing at 3 compartment sink. Basic Burger Tysons (Inspection Date: 05/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed health permit from 2024 posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CDI: EHS advised PIC to contact Fairfax County Environmental Health Dept admin or Basic Burgers corporate office to update address to location of establishment so current permits can be mailed directly to the restaurants.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Follow up scheduled.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: kitchen equipment and utensils at 3 compartment sink. EHS observed no sanitizer being used at 3 compartment sink. EHS observed quat sanitizer solution dispenser not properly working at 3 compartment sink. EHS observed chlorine sanitizer but not in use.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: EHS instructed PIC to contact CFM (off duty) about instructions on free pouring quat sanitizer until dispenser is repaired. EHS assisted PIC with preparing chlorine sanitizer solutions and provided several chlorine test strips until follow up by CFM.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Follow up scheduled.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: sprayer spring in poor repair. Observed makeshift hanger on faucet to hang sprayer without falling below the sink basin flood line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed PIC to repair sprayer spring to permanently fix.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls in the back kitchen area (across from the walk-in refrigerator and shelves under the 4 DRW cooler is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS instructed PIC to clean walls and under shelving in the kitchen area.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. EHS observed cough medicine/ burn relief gel/ tub of ointment cream stored on shelf with sugar and dry spices across form walk in refrigerator in back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: EHS instructed PIC to relocate cough medicine/ burn relief gel/ tub of ointment cream to office until designated employee area is determined by CFM.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed 2 boxes of food stored on the floor (less than 6 inches) inside the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of food to shelf inside the walk in freezer.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Observed cook at flat grill cooking while wearing several bands around wrist.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed cook to remove bands from around wrist while preparing food,

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2025 FOOD ESTABLISHMENT HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS INFORMED THE MANAGER THAT A DUPLICATE 2025 PERMIT WILL BE SENT VIA EMAIL AND PHYSICAL MAIL TO THE ADDRESS OF THE RESTAURANT. ENSURE ONCE RECEIVED IT IS POSTED.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED THE PERSON ON DUTY WITH AN EXPIRED FOOD MANAGER’S LICENSE.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WITH A VALID CREDENTIAL (NOT EXPIRED) ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO COVER THE CUP AND USE A STRAW. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed chemicals stored on shelves with clean equipment and above food like soda syrup.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RE-ORGANIZE HOW THE CHEMICALS/DETERGENTS ARE STORED. THEY SHALL BE STORED SEPARATELY AND BELOW ANY CLEAN EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS, SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS, FOOD, CLEAN LINENS, ETC. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed a working spray bottle of “degreaser” unlabeled.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO LABEL THE WORKING SPRAY BOTTLE.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed personal care items such as Cetaphil, Mucinex, and other personal care items stored above the 3-vat sink and above food prep areas.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DESIGNATE A SHELF BELOW AND SEPARATED FROM FOOD, CLEAN EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS, SINGLE SERVICE, AND CLEAN LINENS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF WATER AND OIL, 2) SHAKERS OF SEASONINGS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ENSURE ALL WORKING CONTAINERS, BOTTLES, BULK BINS, SQUEEZE BOTTLES, SHAKERS, ETC ARE LABELED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE VISIT.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed boxes of food stored in direct contact of the walk-in freezer floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET THE BOXES OF FOOD OFF THE FLOOR AND ONTO NSF APPROVED SHELVING INSIDE THE WALK-IN FREEZER.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of single service items (e.g. take home containers, lids, plastic utensils, etc) stored in direct contact with the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ELEVATE THE ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR ONTO NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE VISIT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed the kitchen walls in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS POINTED OUT AREAS IN THE KITCHEN WHERE THE WALLS CAN BE SCRUBBED TO REMOVE FOOD DEBRIS AND FOOD SPLATTER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE VISIT.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed small gaps/holes in the ceiling panel(s) that need to be sealed.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO SEAL UP THE GAPS/HOLES TO PREVENT ANY ENTRY POINTS FOR INSECTS/RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE VISIT.
